metadata.title: WorkHard — Multi-Trigger Window Visibility Control
metadata.description: Reveal and hide working windows on demand with hotkey, hover, and toggle triggers. A precise desktop productivity tool — multi-monitor and high-DPI aware.

hero.title1: Visible only when you need it —
hero.subtitle1: Reveal and hide working windows with four trigger modes.
hero.subtitle2: Stay focused. Pull up references only when you need them.

modes.subtitle: Show it when you need it, vanish when you don't. The same window calls for different behavior moment to moment. WorkHard lets you combine four triggers freely.

items.name: Hotkey
items.desc: The target window appears only while you hold the assigned shortcut. Release it, and it vanishes — never breaking your flow.
items.example: Hold Ctrl + Space → Visible / Release → Hidden

items.name: Hover
items.desc: The window appears the moment the cursor enters the area and disappears when it leaves. A natural transition — no keypress required.
items.example: Cursor enters area → Visible / Leaves → Hidden

items.name: Both
items.desc: Visible only when both hotkey and hover are satisfied. Perfect when you need to prevent accidental exposure.
items.example: Hold Ctrl while hovering the area → Visible

items.name: Toggle
items.desc: Press the hotkey once to pin it open, again to dismiss. Ideal for references you want to keep around.
items.example: Press Ctrl + Space once → Stays visible

features.subtitle: A small, lightweight tool — but rock-solid inside. Native WPF implementation that runs reliably in any environment.

items.title: Alpha transparency control
items.desc: Smooth 0–255 alpha transitions without destroying the window. Hidden and revealed with zero flicker.

items.title: High-DPI precision
items.desc: Physical and logical pixels are auto-corrected — selection areas match perfectly on 4K and multi-monitor setups.

items.title: Aspect-ratio enforcement
items.desc: Lock to 16:9, 21:9, 4:3, or any custom ratio — based on the client area, not the outer frame.

items.title: Multi-window tracking
items.desc: Register and control many windows at once. Hover and hotkey states sync through a single, consistent state machine.

items.title: Secure auto-update
items.desc: Four-stage integrity check — host allowlist, size guard, stream cap, and SHA-256 hash verification — for safe updates.

items.title: Dark & light auto-switch
items.desc: Detects your system theme automatically and switches Korean / English instantly.

download.subtitle: Completely free. Runs on Windows 10 and above. The installer is delivered with signature and hash verification.

instructions.warning: ⚠ The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen or your antivirus may flag it. That's expected — just follow the steps below.
steps: Click 'Download for Windows' above to fetch the installer.
If 'Windows protected your PC' appears, click 'More info' → 'Run anyway'.
If your antivirus blocks the file, allow or trust it, then try again.
Once the SHA-256 integrity check passes, installation begins automatically.

footer.description: Working windows that surface only when you need them. Keep your flow — and your references — at the same time.
